title: feat(app-shell,plugin-chatbot,i18n): one collapsed line per phase, a result card with its two doors, no navigation after a build (objectui#12724)
body:
Part of #12724 — the plan-card and result-card rows that need the cloud builder-plan-result-payloads-v2 payload stay open (listed below).
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

**Target 2: progress.** A turn's tool activity is one collapsed line per phase: `设计方案 · 4 步 · 0:48 · 读取编写规范 · 列出对象 ×3 · 记录待办 ×2 · 设计应用方案`. Repeated calls of a tool fold into one step with a count. The phase is named for the build tool the turn called (propose_blueprint → 设计方案, apply_blueprint → 搭建). The time is measured while the turn streams; no producer persists a duration, so a reopened conversation shows none. The chevron expands the per-tool rows. They also open on their own while a step runs. A plan waiting on the user does not hold them open, because the plan card says 等待确认 itself. The line now leads its turn, above the design or build panel.

**Target 3, without the verified checklist.** The finished build card reads 「已搭建并上线 · APP」 when the build is live: the envelope says `published`, or this chat's publish signal says so. Without either it still reads 「已构建APP」 ("Built APP"), never claiming it is live. 打开应用 is the primary button: an SPA navigation to `/apps/APP`, the app's first navigation item. 在 Studio 中查看 is secondary: `/studio/PKG/interfaces` with no landing state. In the published posture, the Studio door now gets the build's own package from its envelope. Below the buttons, 「接下来可以说：…」 quotes the envelope's `nextSteps`, followed by 「之后的修改先存草稿，由你在 Studio 发布。」. The progress bar is gone once the build is done. A whole-app build no longer repeats its next steps as a list on the draft card.

**No automatic navigation after a build.** The ChatPane effect that called `paneNavigate('/studio/PKG/interfaces', { state: STUDIO_RUN_LANDING })` when a build landed now only binds the conversation to the built package (A1.b, idempotent), so the Studio dock still resumes the thread. Pins changed: `AiChatPage.builtTransition.test.tsx` (objectui#5799 transition, its full-page opt-out and the objectui#10109 no-transition cases) and `AiChatPage.builtLandsRunning-11658.test.tsx` (objectui#11658 run landing) are retired. Both pinned the navigation this ruling removes. They are replaced by `AiChatPage.noNavigationAfterBuild-12724.test.tsx`. In that file, a reopened build (drafted or published) and a live completion make no router call except the binding's same-conversation `?package=` replace, and never call `location.assign`. The two doors are pinned as SPA navigations with their targets.

**Target 1 (plan card), from what the envelope declares.** `detectProposedPlan` lifts `blueprint.app.label`, plus each field's and each view's `name` and `label`. These are the spec's `SolutionBlueprintSchema` keys (`BlueprintAppSchema`, `BlueprintFieldSchema`, `BlueprintViewSchema`). The card shows 「方案预览 · APP」 with 等待确认, the count line under it, one row per object with a chip per field, one row per view, the assumptions, 开始搭建 / 调整方案 and the reply hint. If no object carries field rows (for example the cache-fallback copy, which keeps only the count), it draws today's object chips.

**Target 4.** Outside an app, the build agent's placeholder is 「描述你想搭建的应用，或要改的地方…」 / "Describe the app you want to build, or what to change…", with no agent name. Inside an app it is still `askOrChangeApp` (objectui#11658). Other agents keep theirs. The footer reads 「↵ 发送 · Shift+↵ 换行」 through a new optional `newlineHint` label.

**i18n.** New keys in every pack: `console.ai.describeAppToBuild`, `console.ai.newlineHint`, `console.ai.viewBuiltAppInStudio`, `chatbot.phase.build|design|stepCount (plural family)|expand|collapse`, `chatbot.plan.awaitingConfirm|objectsAndFields|views` and `chatbot.build.builtAndLive|nextStepsLead|nextStepQuote|draftPosture`. `console.ai.designBuiltApp` retires; 在 Studio 中查看 replaces its label.

## Payload rows left open (cloud builder-plan-result-payloads-v2)

Not drawn, because no current reader or recorded envelope produces them:
- the dashed suggested-field chip (needs a per-field suggested marker);
- the constraint in mono type on a chip, such as 13 位数字 or 邮箱格式 (needs a per-field format constraint);
- the 「名称：自动生成…」 line under relation objects (needs the generated-name rule as display data);
- lifecycle marks on status options (✓完成 / ⚠);
- each view's intent line: layout, group, filter, sort;
- 示例数据 12 条/对象 and 确认后约 1 分钟;
- the example replies in 「也可以直接回复：…」;
- 核对通过 7/7 and the checklist's verified numbers;
- the third button 查看结构.

## Deviations

- `ProposedPlan` (exported from @object-ui/plugin-chatbot) gains three optional members: `appLabel`, `views` and `objects[].fields`. The ruling's field chips need them, but this goes beyond label props and i18n keys. `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation.proposedPlan` now references `ProposedPlan` instead of an inline copy.
- Pins beside the touched surface were updated: the i18n censuses `de-quote-pairing-3876` (one more „…“ pair), `untranslated-identity-4376` (the ko quote format string) and `perm-home-namespace-3546` (the retired key), plus the live-baseline expectation in `useChatConversation.test.tsx`.
- The finished card's primary/secondary order reverses ADR-0080 D5's "Studio primary" per the ruled artboard. The ADR text is untouched.
- The app-shell suite ran as 8 sequential shards; a single run exceeds the container's 10-minute foreground cap.

## Screenshots (1280 px, light; evidence branch, never merged)

Rendered by the real ChatbotEnhanced under the real I18nProvider, from spec-shaped fixture envelopes lifted by the real mapMessages readers. A temporary dev-server page was used and not committed. No live build agent was reachable. Faked inputs: the envelopes, a publish-count probe answering 0, the live build-progress app label, and the clock (+48 s / +64 s while streaming).

## Test evidence (head 38ceb1e)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test`: 62 files, 638 tests passed (run at 781fc10; 38ceb1e touches only an app-shell test).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8`, K=1..8: 1509 files (1508 passed, 1 skipped), 14110 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: 1321 passed, 13 skipped.
- `type-check` (i18n, plugin-chatbot, app-shell), `build` (the same three), eslint on changed files, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0.
- Ablation: each new or updated pin was mutated once on disk and went red, and the restore was proven with `git diff HEAD` empty (11 legs). The first attempt at one leg was a no-op that the ablation tool refused, and it was re-run.

The drafting session's link is in prose here: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XfuGMLXaKo5XaZhNvUTbDL`.
